en: A color photograph of a compact village with red-tiled roofs scattered on green, terraced slopes in a steep alpine valley. A church with a light-colored facade and tall bell tower stands near the center. The surrounding landscape features lush meadows, scattered trees, and dramatic rocky mountains rising sharply in the background under a clear blue sky. The style and colors suggest a mid‑20th‑century printed postcard. No visible text appears on the image side.
